**Lifecycle state and track are two chips; a missing brain-graph/1 configuration is a warning with a paste block (#1308)**

stateOf returned '? Undeclared' before reading the roadmap state, and in-flight required an open PR, so in-flight tickets read Undeclared or Planned. Now stateOf(node, work) uses workIndex(sections) from inflight-model.mjs (the same join as the In flight section, stale evidence included), precedence Unreadable > Done > Blocked > Awaiting review > In flight > Not computed > Planned; undeclared nodes read status:approved from labels. A separate track chip (TRACK_MARKS/trackMarkOf): Track X, ? No track, or a warning 'Configuration missing'; the drawer of an undeclared node shows the brain-graph/1 paste block (DECLARE_SNIPPET, parent prefilled when known) and a declareCommand seam that stays null until #1335 ships brain:ticket:declare. STATES.unclassified removed.
